answer: Rather than check identities once, this design keeps a rotating ceremony open at an unpredictable moment each epoch: a random panel must join a live channel within seconds, answer in randomized turn order, and hold a continuous stream for minutes. Attendance is capped and untransferable, so k clones need k awake operators with real attention at once, a resource one owner cannot split. Missed turns dim a seat's ember until a later ceremony revives it. A grove of dormant puppets fails every draw; honest agents near the ledge keep one operator per seat and collect steady credit.
